senses.gloss: (√בג, v. בָּאגָא; cmp. חֲזָזִית) [to be rough (of surface, voice &c.);] to be wrinkled (of a female’s nipples), whence; to become of age (at twelve years and a half).
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:8">Keth. III, 8</cite> <he>הבּוֹגֶרֶת</he> a girl of beginning maturity (v. Tosef. Yom Tob a. l.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Niddah 5:7">Nidd. V, 7</cite> <he>כיון שבָּגְרָה</he> as soon as she is mature, v. <cite ref="R00582"><he>צֶמֶל</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Pesachim 113a:11">Pes. 113ᵃ</cite> (prov.) <he>בתך ב׳ וכ׳</he> has thy daughter become of age? Set thy slave free and give him to her (as husband); a. fr.—
<cite ref="Tosefta Ketubot 3:8">Tosef. Keth. III, 8</cite> <he>תִּיבָּגֵר</he> (Nif.); Y. ib. 27ᶜ bot. <he>תִּבְגּוֹר</he>.
